messages:
lee: quick thread: thinking about storage costs for keeping prior images for rollback. customers with limited disk can't afford multiple 6GB images. what's our guidance?

hana: use symlink-swap and keep only diffs for incremental releases. for major releases recommend operator do full image retention policy.

mike: can we support a dedupe store for image layers? similar to container registries, local dedupe would reduce footprint. but complexity increases.

upgrade-bot: note: proposed strategy: keep N previous versions where N default=1, configurable per-customer. auto-prune older versions when disk pressure > 70%.

lee: OK. also document recommended disk sizing depending on fleet size. thanks.
